title: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 2.1.2 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Certificate Validation…
description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules versions 2.1.2 through 10.0.3 have an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the iDRACRedfishAPI component. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to potentially cause information exposure and unauthorized access. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.7.
